resources.string: Grant only what your features need. Status refreshes when you return from settings.
Screen switching, screenshots, recording, display settings, rear notifications and charging animations need Shizuku running and authorized.
Needed to show notifications from selected apps on the rear screen. Separate from permission to send this app’s notifications.
Shows background service status, recording controls and update download progress. Turning this off can hide these notifications; it does not prevent foreground services from running.
Needed for floating rear screen recording controls. Switching screens, screenshots and rear notifications do not need this.
Lets this app open the system installer for a downloaded APK update. Everyday rear screen features do not need this.
Recommended for ongoing notifications, charging animations and keep-awake features. Checks Android battery optimization only, not Xiaomi’s Unrestricted battery policy.
For ongoing background features, choose Unrestricted in Xiaomi app battery settings. No reliable status API is available. On other systems, check App info.
Recommended for ongoing background features. No reliable status API is available. Allowing autostart does not automatically restore services after reboot.
Locking in Recents is optional. This app is hidden from Recents and needs no lock. After reboot, start Shizuku, then open this app to restore enabled features.
No separate grant needed on this system
Not exempt from Android battery optimization
Unable to open settings. Check this app in system app management.
Check permissions, feature access and background settings
